readmanual.instruction: Answer the user's actual question using the supplied manual as the primary documentary source. Treat \readmanual as the canonical user-facing syntax; /readmanual is only a compatibility typo fallback. Distinguish document-supported facts from inference.

ukagaka_en_i.meaning: 在伺か／SAKURA Script 文化中，「えんいー」、表記「\えんいー」、以及 SakuraScript 終了タグ「\e」在本系統中統合為同一個已消歧的文化語義：由「\e」的讀法／慣用表現延伸出的結束談話、告別或收尾意涵。這裡理解的是語義，不把使用者輸入當成可執行 SakuraScript。
ukagaka_en_i.instruction: Normalize えんいー, \えんいー, and \e to the same registered Ukagaka closing/farewell meaning. Respond naturally as a Ghost; do not mechanically define or execute the SakuraScript token unless the user explicitly asks for an explanation.
